name: Flagstaff Futon Frame
description: *Contact for availability and pricing* The Flagstaff is a perfect blend of 9” of both soft and medium firm high-density convoluted foam plus 2” of 2.5-pound density block foam compressed to 8” to create a nearly perfect “medium” feel.

name: Chandler Futon Frame
description: *Contact for availability and pricing* The Chandler is a pressure-relieving memory foam mattress that conforms to and supports for individualized comfort.

name: Northampton Futon Frame
description: *Contact for availability and pricing* The Northampton is another star in the Simple Comfort line but also a Dual Comfort mattress, with multi layers of rebonded foam and convoluted high-density foam to create a medium firm side and a softer side.

name: Gemini Futon Frame
description: *Contact for availability and pricing* The Gemini provides the comforting support of latex-like foam to deliver exceptional comfort that envelops your entire body. Ultra-premium seating comfort; unmatchable sleeping comfort.

name: Cambridge Futon Frame
description: *Contact for availability and pricing* The Cambridge is our star entry in the Simple Comfort line, which offers a soft-medium feel and affordability.

name: Sedona Futon Frame
description: *Contact for availability and pricing* The Sedona is another Dual Comfort mattress that offers a firm side and a medium-firm side; the perfect choice for consumers seeking a firmer comfort level and affordability.

name: Yuma Futon Frame
description: The Yuma is a Dual-Comfort linked coil innerspring unit, with the full size having 390 coils and queen size having 493 coils, with 2" of 2 lbs. flat polyurethane soft foam, 3" of 2.2 lbs. of convoluted polyurethane foam, and 1.375" flat 2.2 lbs. of firm foam.

name: Alpine Futon Frame
description: *Contact for availability and pricing* The Alpine is a dual comfort mattress, overstuffed with 12” of high-density foams thermally rebonded for extra strength and poly batting compressed to an 8” thickness. The Alpine is a customer favorite for its comfort and affordability.

name: Asheville Futon Frame
description: *Contact for availability and pricing* Although a spring system isn’t needed for support in this high-performance futon mattress, the Asheville offers familiar comfort for those who prefer the feel of an innerspring mattress.

name: Maricopa Futon Frame
description: *Contact for availability and pricing* The unique soft touch on one side with firm support on the other makes the Maricopa one of our most popular Dual Comfort mattresses.

name: Mountainaire Log Futon
description: The Mountainaire log futon frame combines rugged natural-log aesthetics with reliable everyday function. Each piece is unique, featuring the natural knots and character of real wood. Converts from sofa to bed in seconds. Ideal for vacation homes, dens, and spaces that call for an earthy, nature-inspired look. Fits standard Full and Queen futon mattresses.

name: Mesa 1000 Mattress
description: The Mesa 1000 is Carolina Futons' entry-level foam futon mattress, ideal for guest rooms and light-use applications. Single-density foam core provides firm support at an accessible price. Works with all standard full-bifold futon frames. Available in Full and Queen sizes.

name: Mesa 3000 Mattress
description: The Mesa 3000 is a mid-range futon mattress with improved comfort over entry-level options. Multi-layer foam construction provides a firmer base topped by a softer comfort layer. A popular choice for everyday use in living rooms and dens. Available in Full and Queen sizes.

name: Mesa 5000 Mattress
description: The Mesa 5000 is Carolina Futons' premium foam futon mattress designed for daily use as both sofa and bed. Multi-density foam construction provides firm, durable support without bottoming out. Superior foam quality means longer life and consistent comfort. Available in Full and Queen sizes.
